name: Hans-Peter Zimmermann
bio:
Hans-Peter's unwavering dedication to precision and excellence has made him a cornerstone of the Sprint Masters team. Born and raised in the heart of Switzerland's watchmaking region, his formative years instilled in him a deep appreciation for intricate mechanisms and flawless execution. He transitioned from horology to motorsport, drawn by the challenge of applying his meticulous nature to high-performance engineering.

Prior to joining Sprint Masters, Hans-Peter honed his skills at a leading automotive component manufacturer, where he was responsible for ensuring the highest standards of quality across a range of critical systems. His hands-on approach involves rigorous testing, detailed analysis, and an unwavering commitment to identifying and rectifying even the smallest imperfections. What sets Hans-Peter apart is his ability to combine a relentless pursuit of perfection with a practical understanding of the demands of competitive racing.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: A sturdy man with a focused gaze and a perpetually serious expression.

quirks: Always carries a small magnifying glass to inspect parts.
Insists on using a specific brand of Swiss-made grease for all lubrication tasks.
